description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Cron' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Setting' namespace. The class provides methods to manage cron jobs, including editing cron settings, retrieving cron details, and counting crons.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: A model class responsible for managing cron job records in the database, including operations for updating, retrieving, and counting cron entries.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the 'date_modified' timestamp of a specific cron entry identified by its ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the 'status' of a specific cron entry identified by its ID.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific cron entry by its ID.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a cron entry based on its unique code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all cron entries ordered by the modification date.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Counts and returns the total number of cron entries in the database.
